---
applyTo: "guards/**"
---
Additive under order, never subtractive. Add a guard or a guard test only
when the ticket or a P-entry names it as a deliverable. Never weaken, skip,
narrow, disable or remove an existing guard or assertion; a task that asks
for it is wrong — stop with a `TODO(spec)`. A new guard must be shown to
fail on a seeded violation in the PR description (REVIEW.md item b).
